architecture.mechanism: Vibration-based detection of main journal bearing faults using accelerometer-mounted sensors capturing signatures from both healthy and faulty bearings under diverse climatic and operating conditions
architecture.intervention: Implement factory-level vibration inspection of main journal bearings using tri-axial accelerometer data to detect incipient bearing defects before engine assembly, replacing the software-only recall approach with a mechanical quality-control screening process
architecture.expected_effect: Catastrophic engine bearing failures are prevented at the factory by identifying defective bearings before they reach the field, addressing the root mechanical cause rather than deploying an early-warning software update
architecture.falsification_test: If factory-screened bearings that pass vibration signature testing still experience catastrophic failure in the field at rates comparable to unscreened bearings, the vibration-based detection mechanism is falsified
